<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
update_option( 'stackable_guided_tour_states', array( 'design-system', 'editor', 'design-library', 'blocks' ), false );
$content_file = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/stackable/e2e/config/post-content.txt';
if ( file_exists( $content_file ) ) {
	$id = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
		"SELECT ID FROM {$wpdb->posts} WHERE post_title = %s AND post_type = 'post' AND post_status = 'publish' LIMIT 1",
		'Existing Blocks'
	) );
	if ( ! $id ) {
		$id = wp_insert_post( array(
			'post_title' => 'Existing Blocks',
			'post_status' => 'publish',
			'post_content' => file_get_contents( $content_file ),
		), true );
	}
	if ( $id && ! is_wp_error( $id ) ) {
		update_option( 'stackable_e2e_existing_blocks_post_id', (int) $id, false );
		$seed_dir = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/stackable/e2e/.auth';
		if ( ! is_dir( $seed_dir ) ) {
			mkdir( $seed_dir, 0777, true );
		}
		file_put_contents(
			$seed_dir . '/seed-post.json',
			wp_json_encode( array( 'WP_TEST_POSTID' => (string) (int) $id ) )
		);
	}
}
